I can tell in it's prime this was a really fun game, but with the lack of community I'd have to describe this as unplayable for me. Mainly due to the dead community and not so much the gameplay, because it was more fun solo, due mainly to having nothing but bad groups.  With 12.5 hours on record, I feel I gave it more than a fair shot!


PROS

1. Good mechanics
2. Good Storyline
3. Nice music
4. Mild customization
5. Different class characters

CONS

1. Limited amount of dedicated servers of which are mostly set on highest difficulties or requiring a high level. So not new player friendly.
2. PUG at your own risk. Probably more fun soloing it.
3. [b]FRIENDLY FIRE RUINS THE GAME.[/b]
4. Wanted more options to allow classes to be more unique in their roles.
5. Class specs are a pro, but also a con = Play your intended role!
6. There is not player restrictions of how far they can wander off from group = ruins most runs!
7. Game is dead.


NOTE:] This review is subject to change, but without a solid player base or enough community to make friends and form good teams, it's just a disappointment currently. I wish I played this in it's prime, because its been in my library since it came out. My loss I guess.  Only recommend you play this solo, but I am not into solo games!
It is a fun and fast-pace game, i recomend this to anyone who likes 3rd person shooter games! :D

This game, while small, is a great game from Valve that's like a top down version of Left4Dead except with alien bugs. It runs on the Source engine and enables people to make their own maps which is a plus. I like how weapons are unlockable but the default weapons still can stand a good chance against enemies on higher difficulties. Overall, it's free and I can't think of a reason not to buy it! Valve sure knows how to cater it's fans with free little gems like this game.
